Details 
 Serrano cap is built for performance, comfort, and everyday wear, making it a dependable ranch hat for long days outside. Made from Delta Hydro Flex material, this lightweight country hat is designed to keep you cool with moisture wicking, stain resistant fabric that holds up through work, travel, and outdoor use. The flexible fit and breathable construction make the Serrano an easy choice when you need a western hat that can handle heat, sweat, and movement without losing its shape.
 This ranch hat is made for adventure, whether you are at the barn, on the road, or spending time outdoors. The Hydro Flex material is water friendly and floats, making this country hat a great option for summer days, travel, and active wear. Durable but comfortable, the Serrano keeps its structure while still feeling light enough for everyday use.
 The clean western style pairs easily with your favorite Kimes Ranch jeans, tees, and performance shirts, making this western hat a versatile addition to any outfit. Designed for work, travel, and everyday life, the Serrano is a ranch hat made for people who want reliable performance without giving up classic western style.
 Comfortable, lightweight, and ready for anything, this country hat is built to go wherever the day takes you.
 Fabric: Hybrid Spandex/Jersey
 Fit: Adjustable Snapback | High-Profile | Flat Bill
 Details: Silicone Logo, Perforated Back Panels, Rope Detail
